summary: Candidate for Manager, Investment Structure Management with ~7 years coordinating cross-functional teams through complex analytical and operational deliverables for institutional investors. Supports investing, Finance, Operations, and advisory partners through transaction-related workflows, governance documentation, and post-close maintenance — drawing on multi-asset analytics at Moody's Analytics, IFRS transformation delivery at EY, and pension ALM advisory at Ortec Finance. CFA charterholder; dual MSc; deploys AI tools to streamline analytical workflows and drive continuous improvement in operational processes.
core_skills: Cross-functional coordination (Finance, Legal, Operations, external advisors)
Transaction workflow support and closing project management
Operational process design and continuous improvement
AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) for workflow automation
CFA charterholder; dual MSc (Financial Modelling, Engineering)

sections.heading: Cross-functional Transaction & Analytical Support
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs delivered to multi-asset institutional client portfolios ($5–25bn per engagement; ~$50bn cumulative) — coordinate review across internal modelling, product, and client-facing teams prior to each production release.

Serve as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, interfacing with clients' Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders to resolve structural and methodological complexities across fixed income, derivatives, and multi-asset mandates.
Translate quantitative outputs into committee-ready narratives for senior stakeholders covering exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities.

sections.heading: Governance, Controls & Ongoing Maintenance
bullets: Operate within Moody's formal model-governance framework — independently review assumptions, escalate outputs lacking economic defensibility, and maintain review-trail documentation consistent with institutional control standards.

Prepare analytical summaries for quarterly stakeholder reviews covering interest-rate exposure, scenario impacts, and portfolio sensitivities — supporting visibility into operational and risk metrics.

sections.heading: Process Innovation & AI-Enabled Workflows
bullets: Led design and delivery of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios — replacing a manual spreadsheet workflow with a scalable, auditable platform.

Re-engineered recurring analytical workflows from spreadsheets into Python pipelines with embedded logging and auditability controls, delivering measurable continuous improvement in accuracy and cycle time.

Deployed agentic AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) to automate code generation, validation scaffolding, anomaly detection, and documentation — reducing development cycle time by an estimated 30–40% on comparable modules.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to an enterprise analytics platform — coordinated timelines, milestones, and pre-go-live activities across internal and client stakeholders.

Served as technical liaison between client investment teams and Moody's Product Owners and developers — scoped requirements into structured development requests and tracked implementation timelines through go-live.
Transitioned all assigned client accounts from a legacy Calypso environment to the PFaroe PM platform, validating model outputs post-deployment.

roles.title: Senior Consultant, IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients — aligned regulatory requirements with system implementation, financial-reporting, and governance frameworks.
Coordinated cross-functional delivery across actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and program-management teams on milestone planning, implementation materials, and governance documentation.
Contributed to IFRS 17 advisory product offerings and go-to-market collateral, supporting methodology development and client-facing pursuits.

Delivered ALM studies and Strategic Asset Allocation advisory for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors — analyzed funding ratios, duration alignment, and long-horizon balance-sheet exposures across multi-asset mandates.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform — including risk decomposition, attribution, and near-optimal frontier analysis to test the robustness of allocation recommendations.

Led the onboarding and ALM study for the University Pension Plan (UPP) — a three-plan jointly-sponsored pension merger — on a team of three building and validating the model capturing all Funding Policy dynamics; evaluated duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlay strategies.
Presented findings to investment committees at pension-fund clients and coordinated with internal and external advisors across multi-stakeholder engagements.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) — Western University, 2016
